title: 第6章 人间地狱第7章 连夜送信
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
蒙面人用阴冷的眼光看向高老爷问道“你女儿呢？”高老爷回答道“年三十上午就回去了！”那人点了点头随后手一挥，管家被一剑刺穿了心脏，连惨叫声都没发出来就死了！白衣人冷冷的说道“老家伙！不说实话那天她确实回去了，但是她并没进去，又调头回来了，对吧！”高老爷抬起头看向那蒙面人说道“她没回来，我们也不知道！”蒙面人冷冷的说道“是吗？”随即手又一挥，又一名家丁惨叫一声倒在地上，鲜红的血瞬间就把旁边的雪染红了，是那么的刺眼，那么的醒目，那么的恐怖！
就在这时有一个年轻一点的家丁实在受不了这种气氛了，趁看守他的白衣蒙面人不注意，拔腿就跑负责看守他的那人双脚一点地，人已经来到那人身后，随即一刀向那人脖子砍了过去，紧接着就见那年轻人已经倒在地上，那白衣人则看都没看一眼又走了回来，为首那人说道“不要想着逃跑，这就是下场！”为首白衣人接着说道“你们又谁知道卓正刚妻子在什么地方的吗？”众人又是你看看我，我看看你，因为他们确实不知道！白衣蒙面人看了一下众人以后，继续说道“不说都得死！”此时的高天宇头脑急速思考着，该怎么办？这些人明显不是冲钱来的，他们是过来杀姐姐和外甥的，他们现在这样冷酷残暴，都是为了把姐姐和外甥逼出来！可是他现在却是一点办法都没有，突然他想起自己让管家安排人给姐姐送食物，管家刚刚已经被蒙面人杀了，现场还有一个人知道姐姐的下落，但是他不知道管家派谁去的，他现在就怕这人面临生死的时候会扛不住说出来，这也是人的本性！想到这里，他偷偷的用眼睛看了一下那几个年轻家丁，因为他知道，管家肯定会派一个，年轻力壮的家丁过去的！
就在这时，高夫人突然冲向那个为首的白衣蒙面人说道“你这个杀人魔王，我和你们拼了！”就在她距离那人还有一步的时候，旁边一位白衣人已经一剑刺穿了高老夫人的胸口，老夫人瞬间倒地，没了气息，高老爷和高天宇几乎同时扑向高夫人的尸体，负责看管他们的两位白衣人同时举起剑就要刺向高家父子两，就见为首那人手一挥说道“退下！”那两人连忙向后退去，高老爷不停的呼喊着高夫人“老婆子！老婆子！但是此时的高夫人已经停止了呼吸，再也不会答应他了！高天宇把母亲抱在怀里不停的喊道“娘！你不要走啊！娘！你答应一声啊！”哭的是撕心裂肺！突然高老爷子从地上站了起来，一头向那为首白衣人冲了过去，由于他距离白衣人比较近，众人又都没想到会发生这事，高老爷已经到了那人身边，一头撞向那人胸口，就见那人桀桀一笑，一掌拍向高老爷的脑袋，就听啪的一声，高老爷整个软软的倒了下去，就见他七窍流血，人已经没有了呼吸！“爹”高天宇一声痛呼！转瞬间自己的父母双双惨死在自己面前，是人都受不了这样的打击，他只感觉两眼一黑人瞬间晕了过去！
为首那白衣人连忙让人把高天宇弄醒，他用阴冷的目光看向高天宇说道“你姐姐在什么地方？”高天宇恶狠狠的盯着那人，呸的一声向那人吐了一口痰，，当然被那人轻巧的躲开，随即那人手一挥又一个家丁倒了下去，高天宇此时都要疯了，他无力去改变这些，但是他更不可能把自己的姐姐和外甥出卖了！因为这是姐夫留在这个世界上唯一的血脉！他眼睁睁的看着这个杀人魔王不断的在这里杀人！眼都不带眨一下的！想到自己父母双双惨死！他此刻的双眼已经冒火了！他已经把嘴唇咬破了！鲜血顺着下巴流了下来！他此刻已经抱着必死的心态，但是他知道他暂时还不能死，因为这里还有一个人知道姐姐的下落，他还在想办法阻止这人把姐姐出卖了，因为他知道，就算说出来，今天这个院子里面的人也不会有一个活人的！他们面对的是一帮杀人不眨眼的魔王！虽然他此时悲痛欲绝，但是他头脑里面还在想着，要如何保护好姐姐和外甥！
就在他头脑里面一团乱麻的时候，那为首白衣蒙面人冷漠无情的声音又在他耳边响起来“年轻人！你难道要让这些人都一个一个的死掉吗？”高天宇闻言说道“他们都是无辜的，他们什么都不知道的，你干嘛要滥杀无辜呢？”那为首白衣人冰冷无情的说道“在我们眼里，你们都是蝼蚁，我们只知道完成任务，其他的我们不管，我接到的任务就是，只要是大帅府的人一个不留！但是现在漏了两个人，我的任务没完成！”高天宇说道“你就算杀光了这里所有人也没有用，因为我们真的不知道！”那人桀桀一笑说道“年轻人！你不要侮辱我的智商了！我没有时间和你废话，我再问你一遍，你姐姐在哪里？”高天宇用喷会的眼光看着他一字一顿的说道“不-知-道！”就见那人又把手举了起来！就在这时一个声音说道“我知道！不要杀我，我告诉你们！”高天宇闻言向发出声音的地方看去，只见一个年轻的家丁，浑身颤抖看着身边刚刚被白衣人杀掉的几具尸体，原来这些白衣人是按照顺序杀人的，那为首之人每次挥一下手就杀一个，这次如果再杀就轮到这个年轻的家丁了！就见这人对高天宇说道“少爷！我不想死！我真的不想死！”高天宇重重的呸了他一口，什么话都没说！整个人都瘫了，趴在母亲的尸体上，就见那年轻家丁连滚带爬的来到为首那人面前，扑通一声跪了下来说道“我告诉你们，你们能不杀我吗？为首那人看着眼前的年轻人说道“你说吧！饶你一命！”此时的高天宇趁着刚刚扑倒在母亲尸体上的时候，已经偷偷的把手伸进怀里把匕首握在手里，就在白衣人说完那句话的时候，他使出全身力气扑向那年轻家丁，一刀刺向那人的咽喉，为首白衣人也没想到高天宇明明已经瘫软的趴了下去，怎么会突然跳起来杀人，他连忙一腿就向高天宇踢了过去，可是还是晚了一步，匕首已经刺进那人的咽喉，高天宇也被那白衣人一脚踢飞了出去！那家丁手捂着喉咙鲜血直冒，他挣扎了两下，再也没有了动静！

The masked man looked at Mr. Gao with cold eyes and asked, "Where is your daughter?" Mr. Gao replied, "I will go back on the morning of New Year's Eve!" The man nodded and then waved his hand. The butler was pierced through the heart with a sword, and he died without even letting out a scream! The man in white said coldly, "Old guy! If you don't tell the truth, she did go back that day, but she didn't go in. She turned around and came back, right!" Mr. Gao raised his head and looked at the masked man and said, "She didn't come back, and we don't know either!" The masked man said coldly, "Really?" Then he waved his hand again, and another servant fell to the ground with a scream. The bright red blood instantly dyed the snow next to him red. It was so dazzling, so eye-catching, and so terrifying!
At this moment, a younger servant couldn't stand the atmosphere anymore. When the masked man in white clothes who was guarding him wasn't paying attention, he ran away. The man in charge of guarding him touched the ground with his feet. He had already come behind the man, and then slashed the man's neck with a knife. Then he saw that the young man had fallen to the ground. On the ground, the man in white clothes walked back without even looking at him. The leader said, "Don't even think about escaping, this is what will happen!" The leader in white clothes then said, "Does any of you know where Zhuo Zhenggang's wife is?" Everyone looked at me again, because they really didn't know! After the masked man in white looked at everyone, he continued, "If you don't tell me, you will die!" At this time, Gao Tianyu was thinking rapidly, what should he do? These people obviously didn't come here for money, they came here to kill my sister and nephew. They are so cold and cruel now just to force my sister and nephew out! But now he has no solution at all. Suddenly he remembered that he asked the housekeeper to arrange for someone to deliver food to his sister. The housekeeper had just been killed by a masked man. There was another person at the scene who knew his sister's whereabouts, but he didn't know who the housekeeper sent. Now he was afraid that this person would not be able to bear it when he was facing life or death. This is also human nature! Thinking of this, he secretly glanced at the young servants, because he knew that the housekeeper would definitely send a young and strong servant there!
At this moment, Mrs. Gao suddenly rushed to the leading masked man in white and said, "You murderer, I will fight with you!" Just when she was still one step away from the man, a man in white next to her had pierced Mrs. Gao's chest with a sword. The old lady fell to the ground instantly, breathless. Mr. Gao and Gao Tianyu rushed towards Mrs. Gao's body almost at the same time, responsible for watching. The two men in white who were in charge of them raised their swords at the same time and were about to stab the father and son of the Gao family. The leader waved his hand and said, "Back off!" The two men quickly backed away. Mr. Gao kept calling Mrs. Gao, "Old woman! Old woman!" But at this time, Mrs. Gao had stopped breathing and would never agree to him again! Gao Tianyu held his mother in his arms and kept shouting, "Mother!" Don't leave! mother! Just promise! "The crying was heartbreaking! Suddenly, Mr. Gao stood up from the ground and rushed towards the leader of the man in white. Since he was relatively close to the man in white, no one expected this to happen. Mr. Gao had already reached the man's side and bumped into the man's chest. The man smiled arrogantly and slapped Mr. Gao with his palm. There was a snap on his head, and Master Gao fell down softly. He was bleeding from all his orifices, and he was no longer breathing! "Dad!" Gao Tianyu screamed in pain! In an instant, his parents died tragically in front of him. No one could bear such a blow, and he felt like he fainted instantly!
The man in white at the head quickly asked someone to wake up Gao Tianyu. He looked at Gao Tianyu with cold eyes and said, "Where is your sister?" "Gao Tianyu stared at the man fiercely, and spat at the man with a loud sound. Of course, the man dodged it lightly, and then the man waved his hand and another servant fell down. Gao TianyuYu was going crazy at this time. He was powerless to change this, but it was even more impossible for him to betray his sister and nephew! Because this is the only bloodline my brother-in-law has left in this world! He watched helplessly as this murderous devil kept killing people here! Without blinking an eye! Thinking of both his parents dying tragically! His eyes were already on fire at this moment! He has bitten his lip! Blood flowed down his chin! He has a death mentality at this moment, but he knows that he can't die yet, because there is still someone here who knows the whereabouts of his sister, and he is still thinking of ways to stop this person from betraying his sister, because he knows that even if he tells her, no one in this yard will be alive today! What they are facing is a group of murderous demon kings! Although he was devastated at this time, he was still thinking about how to protect his sister and nephew!
Just when his mind was in a mess, the cold and ruthless voice of the leading man in white rang in his ears again, "Young man! Are you going to let these people die one by one?" Gao Tianyu heard this and said, "They are all innocent. They don't know anything. Why are you killing innocent people indiscriminately?" The leading man in white said coldly and ruthlessly, "In our eyes, you are all ants. We only know how to complete the task. We don't care about the rest. The task I received is, As long as no one from the Marshal's Mansion is left! But now that two people are missing, my mission has not been completed!" Gao Tianyu said, "It's useless even if you kill everyone here, because we really don't know!" The man said with a smile, "Young man!" Man! Don't insult my intelligence! I don't have time to talk nonsense with you. I'll ask you again, where is your sister?" Gao Tianyu looked at him with a stern look and said, "I don't know!" The man raised his hand again! Just then a voice said, "I know! Don't kill me, I tell you!" Gao Tianyu heard the words and looked towards the place where the sound came from. He saw a young servant, trembling all over as he looked at the corpses that had just been killed by men in white. It turned out that these men in white were killing people in order. The leader killed one every time he waved his hand. If he killed again this time, it would be the young servant's turn! I saw this man saying to Gao Tianyu, "Master! I don't want to die! I really don't want to die!" Gao Tianyu gave him a heavy mouthful and said nothing! He was completely paralyzed, lying on his mother's body, and saw the young servant crawling up to the leader, kneeling down with a plop and saying, "I tell you, can you not kill me?" The leader looked at the young man in front of him and said, "Say it!" Spare your life! "At this time, Gao Tianyu, who had just fallen on his mother's body, had secretly reached into his arms and held the dagger in his hand. When the man in white finished speaking, he threw himself at the young servant with all his strength and stabbed the man in the throat. The man in white did not expect that Gao Tianyu was already paralyzed. He lay down softly, how could he suddenly jump up to kill? He quickly kicked Gao Tianyu, but he was still a step too late. The dagger had already penetrated the man's throat, and Gao Tianyu was kicked away by the man in white! The servant covered his throat with blood and he struggled twice, but there was no more movement!
